text: This river is a thousand meters wide.
First instinct: piers all the way across. A beam bridge.
But the river isn't the problem. The ship is.
New rule: no piers in the channel. One span.
asr: New rule, no peers in the channel. One span.

text: Beam: three hundred and thirty. Not close.
Cable-stayed: twelve hundred and eight. Just enough.
The river sets the question. The ship sets the span.
